text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I did it! I got first place!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I worked so hard! But I know I can
work
even harder!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. You know, I—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yooo! Mayano was incredible! Look out,
Arima
Kinen! Here comes your new
champ!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get even more twinkly! And it
sounds
like everyone agrees! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... All right! Another record!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: At this rate, the Arima Kinen is in the—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian, is it true?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: About the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Why are you talking about the future?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I asked you to do a partner run with me.
The
future has nothing to do with that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's... true, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who decides when I'm
finished.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If all you want to do is talk, then just
stand back
and watch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I have running to do.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: W-wait!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...No Umamusume is an island. Do you
think that
you can carve your own way
through the wild
brush? Perhaps so,
but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I won't allow you to leave me behind!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...She's twinkling again.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The longer I stare at her, the more it
hurts. How
can she twinkle so brightly
after all this time?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I just don't get it. She's supposed to be
retiring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Its colors are so much more glorious as it
sets
than in the morning or the
afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And before it does, with just a moment's
glimmer,
it steals everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I feel like if I lose to that light, I'll never
be able
to win again.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run with everything I have at
the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'll give it all I've got... and I will beat her!
